instruction: I need you to remove the account anonym-x2024@outlook.com from my Thunderbird email client

metadata.explanation: This variation asks to remove the account anonym-x2024@outlook.com from Thunderbird using a conversational phrasing ('I need you to'). The evaluator verifies the complete removal of the account by checking both the IMAP server URL and user email are not present in the exported CSV file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts account state using firefox_decrypt.py to export Thunderbird accounts to CSV format
Metric check_csv properly uses 'unexpect' rules to verify the removed account is NOT present in the exported data
Verification checks both url (imap://outlook.office365.com) and user (anonym-x2024@outlook.com), which uniquely identifies the account to be removed
Data flow is semantically correct: postconfig exports accounts → getter retrieves CSV → metric validates absence of specified account
Parameter handling is correct: check_csv receives rules dict directly and accesses rules.get('unexpect', []) as expected
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Evaluator depends on firefox_decrypt.py CSV output format having 'url' and 'user' columns - this is a reasonable assumption but creates external dependency on tool output format
